farmer.name: Young farmer
farmer.blurb: Straw hat and overalls, always smiling.

foreman.name: Foreman
foreman.blurb: Hard hat and safety vest, walkie-talkie always on, there at a call.

auntie.name: Farm auntie
auntie.blurb: Headscarf and apron, every plot's work in her notebook.

grandpa.name: Old hand
grandpa.blurb: White beard, a lifetime of farming, never in a hurry.

gardener.name: Gardener
gardener.blurb: A flower in a wide straw hat, shears in the apron pocket.

robot.name: Robot manager
robot.blurb: A round farm robot whose face screen smiles.

orchestrator.title: Manager
orchestrator.intro: The manager is not a helper: it hears what you want done, sends helpers to do it, watches progress and passes on results.
orchestrator.quiet: The manager has not spoken yet.
orchestrator.about: What it heard, every tool it called (click a row for the arguments and the result), what it said. Newest at the bottom; the last 1000 steps are kept. When a round went wrong, click "This round went wrong" on what it heard, write what it should have done, and it is kept as an eval.
